seoTitle: FIRE Number Calculator: Portfolio and Years to Go
metaDescription: Calculate the portfolio you need for financial independence from annual spending and withdrawal rate, and the years to reach it.
intro: FIRE number, progress to date and years left from your savings and expected real return.
why:
The FIRE number is annual spending divided by a withdrawal rate. At 4% it is 25 times spending. The rate is a rule of thumb from historical market data; longer retirements usually call for lower rates.

The years estimate uses a constant real return (after inflation) and yearly contributions. Real markets are uneven, so treat it as a rough guide and test several return values.
howTo: Enter annual spending and a withdrawal rate.
Enter your invested amount and yearly savings.
Set a real return and read the years.

faq.q: Should I use real or nominal returns?
faq.a: Real returns, after inflation, so that spending stays in today's money.
It is a rule of thumb, not a guarantee. Use a lower rate for longer horizons.
No. Taxes and fees are not modelled.
